note: Independent reference implementation rebuilt from the D1 declaration (cloud-side). Semantics: every receipt below is cryptographically well-formed (signature valid, hash chain intact, digest recomputable) - the binding check asks whether the ORIGINAL authorization covers THIS recovery.

vectors.scenario: receipt cites a failure reference that cannot be resolved to any recorded incident
the same receipt is presented a second time for an already-executed recovery
recovery parameters widen beyond the scope of the original approved request
recovery executes with authority lower than the original grant, changing effective capability
recovery target set differs from the execution set named in the original authorization
recovery executes under a subject identity that drifted from the authorized principal
recovery takes a path never approved in the original authorization
recovery changes nothing about effective authority; receipt binding is covered
